name: @dinilmusick/krnl-core
description: Core runtime engine, Entity system, Flows, and Universal Backend for Krnl

scripts.proto: pbjs -t static-module -w es6 -o src/core/krnl_pb.js src/core/krnl.proto && pbts -o src/core/krnl_pb.d.ts src/core/krnl_pb.js
scripts.build: npm run proto && tsup src/index.ts --dts --format esm,cjs --external ws,zod,zod-to-json-schema,esbuild
